Title: LSJ- No Secrets and Daring the Dawn

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If a vampire A with No Secrets from the Magaji tries to block a
vampire B. If the acting vampire A then plays Daring the Dawn. Does
No Secrets from the Magaji burn?

I think the answer is yes, but several players disagree

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> If a vampire A with No Secrets from the Magaji tries to block a

> vampire B. If the acting [vampire B] then plays Daring the Dawn. Does

> No Secrets from the Magaji burn?
>
> I think the answer is yes, but several players disagree

Yes. Card text: "Burn this card if this magaji attempts to block a vampire but
is not successful."

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


How do they disagree? Did you point out that the cards have text on
them? And that it does, indeed, apply?

I mean, assuming "the acting vampire A the plays Daring the Dawn"
actually means that the actual acting vampire (B) plays it, since A is
"trying to block" and thus not eligible to play DtD.
